streak_assessment: Two consecutive scientific non-improvements since the exp-0089 promotion: exp-0090 (quadratic king-danger, arena 18-29-17, score 0.508, CI [0.436,0.580], inconclusive) and exp-0091 (rank-scaled passed-pawn bonus, arena 21-26-17, score 0.531, CI [0.459,0.602], inconclusive). The handoff stop rule is five consecutive non-improvements AND no materially different well-motivated experiment left; neither clause is met. The exp-0091 record's own counter reads 1 while the fixed context says 2; either way the streak is far below threshold. The search / move-ordering / quiescence / time-management family is genuinely exhausted in its tested form (history/killer/TT-best-move ordering, aspiration windows, guarded null-move, bounded check extensions/evasions, forcing-check priority, mate-distance, quiescence promotions/delta pruning, draw contempt, halfmove-clock TT bucketing, timeout unwinding, quiescence stalemate repair, ordering-key micro-opt, clock allocation), but the leaf-evaluation direction opened by exp-0089 is young and productive: mobility was accepted, and the two positional terms since have trended upward toward the acceptance line (0.508 -> 0.531) without any reliability, ablation, CI or resource regression. Multiple distinct, never-tried positional terms remain (rook activity on open/half-open files, bishop pair, king pawn-shield safety as a structurally different mechanism from exp-0090's attacked-ring count, non-linear or phase-scaled mobility). This is not saturation.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced threefold-repetition draws from equal-or-better positions remain the dominant outcome (25 of 64 games ended by threefold repetition, 1 by insufficient material). PGNs show aimless shuffling with no progress plan once the position simplifies, frequently queen perpetual-style oscillation (e.g. Qg6/Qg1 vs Qf7/Qe7) and rooks rocking between two squares on a closed file (Rc1-Rc2-Rc1, Re3-Rf3-Rc2). The passed-pawn term nudged the score but did not fix this.

All 17 losses are checkmates, with roughly 13 of 17 occurring when the candidate had White. They are long king-hunts: some middlegame (loose early queen sorties in the forced opening lines leaving the king exposed), many in simplified endgames where the engine has equal or extra material, promotes a pawn or two, and is then mated by the opponent's activated rook plus queen. exp-0090 targeted a static king-attack scalar directly and had no effect, indicating the mates are downstream of passive defence and weak endgame technique rather than a missing king-danger term.

Endgame conversion failure: the engine repeatedly reaches rook or rook-and-pawn endings with an extra passed pawn or a pawn majority and neither advances the passer (exp-0091 targeted this, mild positive only) nor activates its rook to the open file, so winning or clearly-better endings decay into repetition draws or, after over-pressing, into losses.

next_direction.title: Rook on open / half-open file term in the leaf evaluation
next_direction.hypothesis: Add a cheap fixed rook file-status bonus to _model_evaluate. Before the `for colour, sign` loop (or once per call), fetch the two pawn bitboards as plain ints: white_pawns = board.pieces_mask(chess.PAWN, chess.WHITE) and black_pawns = board.pieces_mask(chess.PAWN, chess.BLACK). Inside the existing `for colour, sign` / `for piece_type` loop, when piece_type == chess.ROOK, set own_pawns/enemy_pawns from those two ints by colour and compute file_bb = chess.BB_FILES[chess.square_file(square)]. If file_bb & own_pawns == 0 and file_bb & enemy_pawns == 0, add sign * ROOK_OPEN_FILE (a fixed constant, ~18 cp). Else if file_bb & own_pawns == 0 (own side has no pawn on the file but the enemy does), add sign * ROOK_HALF_OPEN (~9 cp). Apply the bonus flat: no phase scaling, and no doubled-rook, rook-on-7th, rook-behind-passed-pawn, or connected-rooks sub-terms in this first version so the mechanism is tested cleanly. This gives alpha-beta a monotone reason to lift a rook onto the one open file and to create or preserve open files for its rooks, a progress signal that mobility (near-constant among quiet rook moves along a closed file) and the file-agnostic tapered PSQT do not express, directly targeting the passive-rook shuffling and passive-rook endgame losses seen across the exp-0091 repetition-draw and checkmate PGNs.
next_direction.rationale: The dominant retained failure modes are non-forced repetition draws from equal-or-better positions with rooks shuffling on closed files, and lost simplified endgames where the rook never activates. exp-0091's passed-pawn term moved the arena from 0.508 to 0.531 but stayed inconclusive, and the previous audit's own guardrails explicitly pre-authorised rook-on-open-file as the next distinct positional term after an inconclusive passed-pawn arena, with bishop pair after that. Rook file activity is the canonical rook-endgame and middlegame progress heuristic, has never been tried in this project (absent from the experiment registry and from both exhausted-mechanism lists), and is fully self-contained: one documented-API bitboard AND per rook plus two hand-chosen constants, no move generation, no board.push, no new weights artifact, no training pipeline. It is preferred over bishop pair because it targets the largest combined loss-plus-draw column (passive-rook middlegames and rook endings) rather than a near-constant material scalar, and preferred over another king-safety term because exp-0090 already showed a static king-danger scalar does not move the needle.
next_direction.guardrails: Keep the trained PSQT model and the accepted mobility term dominant: ROOK_OPEN_FILE must stay <= ~22 cp and ROOK_HALF_OPEN <= ~12 cp, so a realistic worst case (both rooks on fully open files) contributes under ~0.45 pawn, far below the model's ~118-170 cp margin RMSE, and no single-piece contribution approaches a minor piece. NPS / leaf-cost budget: fetch the two pawn bitboards once per _model_evaluate call as plain ints (board.pieces_mask); per-rook work is one chess.square_file call, one chess.BB_FILES index, and two int-AND truthiness tests, with no chess.popcount, no second legal-move generation, no board.push, and no per-leaf object allocation. exp-0091's stress showed the worst single move at the 120 s clock was 0.55 s against the 2.25 s ceiling and 0.04 s against 0.75 s at the 1 s clock, so keep the added leaf cost within roughly 1.2x. Use only documented python-chess API (chess.BB_FILES, chess.square_file, board.pieces_mask); never read library internals and never touch any path outside agent.py and weights/. No change to _budget_seconds, the iterative-deepening loop, move ordering, quiescence, or the transposition table. Must pass the full stress_time_left_ms grid (1 / 25 / 100 / 1000 / 120000) with required_failures 0 and init under 50 s, and must hold model-move-ablation minimum_strength_score >= 0.625 with >= 8 divergent moves at the 3 s ablation clock. If the paired arena is inconclusive, do NOT re-tune ROOK_OPEN_FILE / ROOK_HALF_OPEN, add phase scaling, or bolt on doubled-rook / rook-on-7th / rook-behind-passer / connected-rook sub-terms and call it a new experiment; move to the bishop-pair term, and if that is also inconclusive, flag an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json (rook, king-shelter and pawn-structure features) for the human before declaring scientific saturation.

audit_summary: Champion is agent.py at commit 4a0c988 (recorded as exp-0089): a PVS/LMR negamax with exchange-aware capture ordering and losing-capture pruning in quiescence, a depth-keyed transposition table, partial root-iteration salvage, a fast draw/terminal path, over a tapered learned piece-square model, plus the accepted fixed 3 cp/square net-mobility leaf term and a flat castling-rights scalar. exp-0091 (the previous audit's chosen next step) added a rank-scaled passed-pawn bonus to _model_evaluate using import-time front-span masks and a fixed coefficient tuple, and returned an inconclusive paired arena (21-26-17, score 0.531, CI [0.459, 0.602]) with CI, reliability stress (worst move 0.55 s vs the 2.25 s ceiling), model-move-ablation (29 divergent moves vs 8 required), ruff, mypy, resource and policy-test gates all clean and zero agent failures. It was not promoted, so passed pawns are not in the champion. That is the second consecutive scientific non-improvement since the exp-0089 promotion (threshold five), and it is not saturation: the search/ordering/quiescence/time family is exhausted in its tested form, but the leaf-evaluation direction has only had mobility (accepted), king danger (exp-0090, inconclusive 0.508) and passed pawns (exp-0091, inconclusive 0.531) reach the arena, with the score trending toward the acceptance line. Auditing exp-0091's retained games, the failure modes are unchanged: non-forced threefold-repetition draws from equal-or-better positions (25 of 64 games), with PGNs showing aimless queen and rook shuffling in simplified positions and rooks left passive on closed files; and all 17 losses are checkmates, skewed toward the candidate playing White, in long middlegame and endgame king-hunts, several after reaching an equal-or-better rook ending, confirming exp-0090's result that a static king-attack scalar does not help and the mates are downstream of passive defence and weak rook-endgame technique. Decision: CONTINUE. Next experiment adds a cheap fixed rook-on-open-file / rook-on-half-open-file bonus to _model_evaluate: two board.pieces_mask pawn-bitboard fetches per call, one chess.BB_FILES AND per rook, hand-chosen constants (~18 cp open, ~9 cp half-open), applied flat with no sub-terms, no move generation and no board.push. This is a materially new mechanism (rook file activity has never been tried; absent from the registry and both exhausted lists) and is the previous audit's explicitly pre-authorised fallback after an inconclusive passed-pawn arena. It keeps the trained model dominant (contribution well below the model's ~118-170 cp margin RMSE), holds one CPU / 2 GB / no network, and does not touch search, time management or any protected surface. If it is inconclusive, bishop pair remains, followed by flagging an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json for the human before declaring scientific saturation. Uploading remains out of scope; the live upload is a newer separate artifact (state.json live_submission commit 1b07bbe) and this audit does not touch it.
